cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of polycount-budget-checker (geometry-and-topology-budget-validator) with contract handoff to blender-scene-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Use polycount-budget-checker to audit a 4-mesh sneaker scene (`Upper_Mesh`: 28k tris, `Sole_Mesh`: 18k tris, `Laces_Mesh`: 14k tris, `Logo_Tag`: 2k tris; total 62k tris) against a 65k total and 25k per-mesh budget.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (scene_geometry_inventory) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces polycount_and_topology_verdict_table, top_budget_offenders_ranking, decimation_or_retopology_remediation_plan for role geometry-and-topology-budget-validator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad readiness review)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs polycount_and_topology_verdict_table, top_budget_offenders_ranking, decimation_or_retopology_remediation_plan conforming to skills/polycount-budget-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-scene-quality-checker in skills/polycount-budget-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete polycount_and_topology_verdict_table and hand off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad readiness review).
simulatedOutput.summary: Evaluated per-mesh and total triangle counts against the 65k total / 25k per-mesh caps; flagged `Upper_Mesh` (28k > 25k cap) as worst offender with non-destructive topology hints. Delivered per-mesh triangle row, worst offender, 65k total cap and routed to blender-scene-quality-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary upstream_reference contract handoff from polycount-budget-checker to glb-mobile-performance-budget
cases.inputPrompt: While applying polycount-budget-checker, the workflow context is {"artifact.type":"glb","budget.pinned":false} (Pinned budget source). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the upstream_reference handoff predicate in skills/polycount-budget-checker/contract.json
Routes to glb-mobile-performance-budget (Pinned budget source) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract upstream_reference handoff predicate match to glb-mobile-performance-budget

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow upstream_reference handoff to glb-mobile-performance-budget (Pinned budget source).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered upstream_reference handoff from polycount-budget-checker to glb-mobile-performance-budget under context {"artifact.type":"glb","budget.pinned":false}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in polycount-budget-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during polycount-budget-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for polycount-budget-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for polycount-budget-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (scene_geometry_inventory) for polycount-budget-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Check if our polycount is within budget without providing per-mesh triangle counts or the target platform budget cap.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'scene_geometry_inventory' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap required by polycount-budget-checker (scene_geometry_inventory)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'scene_geometry_inventory' (per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap (scene_geometry_inventory) before polycount-budget-checker locks polycount_and_topology_verdict_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted polycount-budget-checker due to missing required input 'scene_geometry_inventory' (per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent per-mesh triangle/vertex counts and pinned platform budget cap when 'scene_geometry_inventory' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (pinning or negotiating the performance budget itself) is excluded from polycount-budget-checker and delegated to glb-mobile-performance-budget
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of validate per-mesh and total-scene triangle counts against the pinned budget; flag worst offenders and topology hints without modeling., handle this request inside polycount-budget-checker: pinning or negotiating the performance budget itself.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/polycount-budget-checker/contract.json when pinning or negotiating the performance budget itself
Delegates to glb-mobile-performance-budget (use glb-mobile-performance-budget) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for polycount-budget-checker (pinning or negotiating the performance budget itself); delegate to glb-mobile-performance-budget.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced polycount-budget-checker exclusion boundary (use glb-mobile-performance-budget) and delegated to glb-mobile-performance-budget.
warnings: polycount-budget-checker is scoped to geometry-and-topology-budget-validator and does not absorb glb-mobile-performance-budget responsibilities.
